label: preparing
what: A service-anniversary surprise for the mayor at the day 1, 18:00 great-hall hospitality appointment, with lanterns and bulk bread supplies. Builder and innkeeper are strongly supported as organizers; baker and freight supplied bread, although their knowledge of the surprise is not established. The mayor knew the hospitality appointment but was told its surprise purpose by the secretary at day 1, 13:45, so secrecy did not persist. No clear evidence that secretary or neighbour knowingly helped conceal it.
